## Lecture outline (draft)

- **Problem:** Reconstruct a function from points when the function itself is known (the reference), and see why more nodes are not always better.
- **Tools:** the Lagrange polynomial, the Runge phenomenon, Chebyshev nodes, splines, least squares, the danger of extrapolation.
- **Lead author:** Kirill Bazarov.
